AUCTUM GMBH · GERMANY

Spanish ceramic tiles – factory stock

Factory stock of a Spanish ceramic tile manufacturer: about 210,000 m² of floor and wall tiles in some 1,700 references – hexagons 25 and 56 cm, 25 × 25, 44 × 66, Kayak 17 × 33, Provenzal, 50 × 50, 66 × 66, 33 × 66, modular patterns and wood-look planks – plus about 552,000 special pieces: skirting, steps, borders, trims, inserts and corners. About 81 % of the m² is 1st choice. On pallets in the original boxes. Stock list of 14 October 2026; quantities change while the stock is being sold.
